title: World Home Economics Day 2025: Tackling Overconsumption Through Education
reason: The video describes educational and promotional activities related to agriculture and food security.

tasks.task: Describe the celebration and events for World Home Economics Day at Castro's Comprehensive Secondary School.

subtasks.text: Observe the excitement at the school as students prepare to celebrate World Home Economics Day.
Note the focus on sustainable agricultural practices during the event.
Highlight the role of the vocational department in hosting the event and showcasing food security initiatives.
Note the presence of the Ministry of Agriculture and their interest in integrating aquifood systems development into the curriculum.
Watch Dr. Randall Esnard deliver an address on the importance of local food production and youth engagement in agriculture.
Observe students participating in interactive sessions and food preparation demonstrations.
Note the Ministry of Agriculture's educational booth featuring live demonstrations of sustainable farming techniques.

tasks.task: Describe the future plans for education and partnerships related to agriculture.
